verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a view of the user's own observability spend, cost attribution to teams or services, or usage-spike alerting tied to billing. The cost mentions are adjacent: predictable storage via time series data streams and tiered storage, LLM app cost tracking, and profiling to reduce cloud spend. Generic log-threshold alert rules are a building block, not a spend-monitoring capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
